title: AgentMemoryGotchas
description: Schema for the agent gotcha registry (default path: agent_memory/gotchas.json) — cross-agent pitfall registry.

id.description: Unique gotcha identifier in the format G-YYYY-NNN.

rule.description: Human-readable description of the pitfall or rule to follow.

workflow_kinds.description: Agent workflow kinds this rule applies to, e.g. 'fix-issue', 'pr-review', 'pr-merge', 'pr-triage', 'pm'. Matched against the invoking CI workflow name via the preflight workflow-kind mapping (preflight.workflow_kinds in corral.yaml). Schema v2: replaces the overloaded `applies_to_surfaces` field, which previously held either workflow-kind strings or file paths interchangeably and could never match the file-path-only briefer selector.

repo_paths.description: Repo-relative file path globs (e.g. 'src/api/orders.py', 'config/*.yaml') this rule applies to. Glob-matched (fnmatch) against the briefer's `files_to_touch`.

surface_ids.description: Surface-registry keys (surfaces.yaml) this rule applies to (e.g. 'payments-config'). Matched against the briefer's `surfaces_in_scope`.

source_prs.description: PR numbers that motivated this gotcha.

source_refs.description: Non-PR evidence source refs that motivated this gotcha, such as sanitized session-memory or audit-log pointers.

control_type.description: Type of automated control that enforces this rule.

control_pr.description: PR number that introduced the control, or null if not yet implemented.

control_path.description: Repo-relative path to the control file, or null if not yet implemented.

inject_into_briefer.description: Whether this rule should be injected into agent briefing prompts.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this gotcha was created (YYYY-MM-DD).

expires.description: ISO 8601 date when this gotcha expires and should be removed, or null if permanent.
